title: Bose QuietComfort Ultra Wireless Noise Cancelling Headphones, Black — Immersive Audio, 24-Hour Battery
bullets: Industry-leading noise cancellation with eight microphones and the Integrated Processor V1 for quieter flights and offices.
Up to 30 hours of battery life with Quick Attention and Speak-to-Chat so you can talk without removing the headset.
Multipoint Bluetooth connects two devices at once — switch from laptop calls to phone music without re-pairing.
description: The WH-1000XM5 is Sony's flagship over-ear noise canceling headphone aimed at frequent travelers and remote workers who need silence without sacrificing audio detail.

reviews.author: Chris L.
reviews.title: Flight essential
reviews.body: NC on a transatlantic flight was dramatically better than my XM3s. Speak-to-Chat is surprisingly natural once you enable it in the app.

reviews.author: Nina V.
reviews.title: Comfortable for 8-hour workdays
reviews.body: I wear these on back-to-back Zoom calls. Clamping force is gentler than XM4 and the mic quality gets compliments from coworkers.

aplus.heading: From the manufacturer
paragraphs: Sony has refined the 1000X series across five generations with a focus on noise canceling algorithms and comfort.

qa.question: Can I use these wired?
qa.answer: Yes. A 3.5 mm cable is included. ANC can still run while wired if the battery has charge.
